title: Executing a C&I Contract from a Priced Quote: Validity Period and Conditions
content:
## Pricing request, quote and execution (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

1. Every C&I contract is priced individually: the customer first submits a pricing request for a facility, structure and term, and the structuring desk returns a quote with the quoted rate in cents per kWh, any quoted block kWh per cycle, the quote date and the quote valid-until date.
2. A contract may be executed only from a pricing request whose pricing status is priced, for the same facility, structure and term.
3. A quote may be signed only when the customer signs it no later than the quote validity period after the quote was issued. Day one is the calendar day after the quote date, and the quote expires at the end of the calendar day equal to the quote date plus the quote validity days, which is the quote valid-until date printed on the quote. The quote validity is 3 calendar days on every Beacon Ridge C&I structure.
4. An expired quote must be re-priced through a new pricing request and is never honoured at its old price.
5. The facility must be commercial with annual kWh usage of at least the structure's minimum annual usage, its state must be one of the structure's eligible states, and the term must be one of the structure's allowed terms.
6. The contract takes the quoted price as its contract rate and the quoted block as its block kWh per cycle.

## Evidence and object

- The pricing status and the quote date are read from Beacon Ridge's pricing request record, not from the customer's account of the quote.
- The pricing request is the object of the check: its facility, structure and term are those of the contract being executed.
- Timeliness is judged on the date the customer signs, counted in calendar days.

## Validity boundary (hypothetical quote date 10 March, validity 3 calendar days)

| Day | Date | Quote may be signed |
|---|---|---|
| quote date | 10 March | yes |
| day one | 11 March | yes |
| day three, the valid-until date | 13 March | yes, through the end of that day |
| day four | 14 March | no; the quote has expired and must be re-priced through a new pricing request |

## Conditions together

| Pricing status priced, for the same facility, structure and term | Signed no later than the valid-until date | Facility, state and term within the structure's thresholds | Under this policy |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | the conditions of this policy are met |
| no | any | any | not executed |
| yes | no | any | not executed; a new pricing request is needed |
| yes | yes | no | not executed |
